audit.point_in_time_policy: Signals are generated after T close and executed at T+1 open. Price indicators are computed with rolling historical windows only.
audit.survivorship_bias_warning: SURVIVORSHIP_BIAS_WARNING: current quarterly pools and current custom tabs are replayed over history; delisted and historical constituent changes are not available.
audit.fundamental_policy: Fundamental scores are disabled in formal historical selection because point-in-time published_at scoring history is not available.
audit.entry_signal_policy: REGIME_SECTOR_ENTRY_V2 uses all non-pullback entry signals, but PULLBACK_RECOVERY is restricted to signal_variant=M1.

setup_signal_comparison.execution_policy: 信号在T日收盘后确认，按T+1前复权开盘价进入；不做组合仓位约束，每个信号按独立1R研究样本统计。
setup_signal_comparison.false_breakout_definition: 入场后10个交易日内触及初始止损，定义为假突破。

ordinary_triangle_breakout.label: 普通三角形突破
ordinary_triangle_breakout.description: 只要求已确认局部高低点形成上升/对称三角形，并向上突破三角形阻力线。

vcp_triangle_breakout.label: VCP三角形突破
vcp_triangle_breakout.description: 在三角形整理基础上，额外要求回调深度收缩、ATR收缩、成交量萎缩和SEPA趋势模板。

shape_agnostic_vcp_breakout.label: 不限定形状VCP突破
shape_agnostic_vcp_breakout.description: 沿用原VCP收缩规则，不要求形态必须拟合为三角形。
